# MacBook Repair Dubai

> MacBook Repair Dubai is an independent Apple repair specialist in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, in business since 10 October 2004. The workshop is Mac-first (MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, iMac, Mac mini, Mac Studio and Mac Pro, down to board level) and also repairs iPhone and iPad. Customers walk in at Office #45, 10th Floor, Concord Tower, Al Sufouh, Dubai Media City, or send the device using a same-day courier they book themselves. Paid onsite visits are available subject to technician availability. Repair quotes are given on WhatsApp at +971 55 741 3706.

## How a repair works

- Diagnosis is free.
- Repair prices are not published on the site. Every repair is quoted on WhatsApp once the model and fault are known, before any work starts.
- Walk in at Office #45, 10th Floor, Concord Tower, Al Sufouh, Dubai Media City (across from Media City Metro, parking on site). Customers who can't come in can book any same-day courier app themselves and send the device to the workshop; returns are collected from the workshop or sent back by a courier the customer books. The workshop does not collect or deliver devices. Paid onsite visits are available subject to technician availability, with the charge quoted on WhatsApp first.

## Warranty

A written warranty of up to 12 months, depending on the repair:

- Hardware repairs (ports, trackpad, hinge, fan, speaker, SSD and RAM and similar): 12 months
- Battery replacement: 3 months, with an 80% capacity guarantee
- Screen replacement: 90 days
- Keyboard, software, logic-board, liquid-damage and data-recovery work: 15 days
- Unlock services carry no parts warranty
